update.broken.byMove: After the move, "{path}" in {via} of {at} no longer resolves. {hint}
update.broken.targetGone: What {via} of {at} points to is gone
update.changed.name: name set to {name}
update.changed.strayDropped: removed fields not in the shape: {names}
update.changed.strayUndefined: removed fields not in the definition: {names}
update.doc.fieldsNotObject: The document's fields is not an object
update.doc.rowsNotObject: The document's rows is not an object
update.error.containerHolds: {card} holds {held} ({heldKind}), so it cannot become {next}. Move or delete it first
update.error.docViewKind: Only formatdoc cards can choose between a rows view and a document view (not {kind})
update.error.ghostPointsHere: Moving {card} to section {section} would make the card ghost {ghost}, which points to it, point to something in its own section. Delete or re-point the card ghost before moving
update.error.keyOnlyOn: {key} can only be written on {holders} ({card} is {kind})
update.error.kindNotCreatable: {kind} is a kind that cannot be created
update.error.noContainerCard: The container card does not exist
update.error.noEnumDef: There is no definition for enum
update.error.notResizable: A {kind} card cannot have a size (a flow node is drawn by its node's shape, a card ghost at the size of the card it leads to)
update.error.ofOnlyDataTable: of can only be written on instance and table cards ({card} is {kind})
update.error.ofPath: of is the path of the entity or value that gives the shape (e.g. Schema:Order)
update.error.ownKindLacks: {key} is neither a field nor a row of {kind} ({card} is {kind}; it has {names}. See its definition in guide, about: {kind})
update.error.sizeRange: The size is 4 to 60 cells wide and 2 to 120 cells high (not {size})
update.error.sizeShape: size is {"w": integer} or {"w": integer, "h": integer} (in cells; a height alone cannot be written)
update.error.standaloneKind: standalone (show on its own in the diagram) is only for value and enum cards ({kind} is always shown as a card)
update.error.stranded: {card} has {held}, so it cannot become {kind}. Empty it first
update.error.strayMissingNone: {card} has no field "{missing}" outside the definition (there are none)
update.error.strayMissingSome: {card} has no field "{missing}" outside the definition (there are {names})
update.error.strayOnlyDelete: strayFields only removes (no value can be written at {key}. To write a value, add a field to the kind definition and write it by that name)
update.error.strayShape: strayFields is null (remove every field not in the definition) or {"<place>": null} (remove only that place)
update.error.switchBoard: {card} is {current}, so it cannot become {next} (goal and task cannot be switched to or from other kinds. Create it again)
update.error.switchData: {card} is {current}, so it cannot become {next} (instance and other kinds cannot be switched to or from each other. Create it again)
update.error.switchTable: {card} is {current}, so it cannot become {next} (table and other kinds cannot be switched to or from each other. Create it again)
update.error.toGhost: {card} is a card, so it cannot become a card ghost (create a card ghost with card_create, using kind: ghost and target in value)
update.error.topLeftRange: x and y of topLeft are from -{reach} to {reach} (in cells)
update.error.valueTooLong: A value must be 80 characters or fewer
update.error.valuesItem: Each element of values is a text, or an object with name (and label)
update.error.versionKind: Only stackdoc cards can choose which version is open (not {kind})
update.error.versionValue: version is the name of a version or null
update.error.viewValue: view is rows, document or null
update.error.writtenNotReadBack: The card that was written cannot be read back
update.line.cardsMovedCapped: Moved {count} items to section {section} ({names} … and {more} more)
update.tags.noKey: tags cannot have {other}. An array replaces the tags; an object takes only add and remove
update.tags.noWay: Write add or remove in tags (an array replaces them)
update.tags.notList: tags.{key} must be a list of tags (strings)
update.unresolved: The path "{path}" in {via} does not resolve. {hint}
update.warn.dataStrayDropped: The value of {card}.{at} (a field not in the shape) was dropped because the container was not written
update.warn.movedOut: Moved {names} inside {full} out to where {full} was
update.warn.pathsRewrittenByMove: Rewrote {rewritten} paths written in the project to follow the move
update.warn.pathsRewrittenByName: Rewrote {rewritten} paths written in the project to {name} to follow the name
update.warn.pathsRewrittenByRows: Rewrote {rewritten} paths written in the project to follow the rows
update.warn.placedNearby: It overlaps {over} or falls within the margin around it (layout.margin in project_read), so it was placed in a nearby free cell (x: {x}, y: {y})
update.warn.placedNearbyInContainer: It overlaps another card or falls within the margin around one (layout.margin in project_read), so it was placed in a nearby free cell ({at})
update.warn.sizeOverlaps: With its new size it overlaps {over} or falls within the margin around it (layout.margin in project_read). It was not moved (place it again with topLeft, or tidy with section_update)
